channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by critical remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws targeting Microsoft ecosystems across desktop operating systems, cloud infrastructure, network services, and database platforms. Memory corruption issues such as heap and stack buffer overflows, alongside unsafe deserialization and injection vulnerabilities, remain the primary attack vectors enabling unauthenticated exploitation and lateral movement. The widespread impact spans enterprise endpoints, Azure cloud services, SQL Server instances, and developer toolchains, underscoring an urgent need for comprehensive patching across identity management, web applications, and network infrastructure components.
